description: AI rich text editor SDK for React, Next.js, Vue, Svelte, Angular, Laravel and vanilla JS
rules: Install with `npm install eddyter` and import 'eddyter/style.css'
Wrap ConfigurableEditorWithAuth in EditorProvider and pass an apiKey from https://eddyter.com/user/license-key
In the Next.js App Router, put the editor in a 'use client' component
AI features (chat, autocomplete, refinement, image generation) are enabled per API key in the Eddyter dashboard, not in code. There is no aiOptions, ai, enableAI or autocomplete prop.

Use the package for the framework: @eddyter/vue, @eddyter/svelte, @eddyter/angular, @eddyter/core (vanilla JS), @eddyter/react-native, or eddyter/laravel (Composer). The eddyter package is for React and Next.js only.
